description: A minimalist, low-polygon 3D model of a flat-screen television. It features a dark gray bezel and a stand with a lighter gray base. The screen itself is a bright, pale blue, suggesting it is either on or displaying a light-colored image. The overall aesthetic is simple and clean, with sharp edges and flat surfaces characteristic of a voxel or low-poly art style. The lighting suggests a subtle shadow cast by the screen onto itself, adding a touch of depth. It's a modern and functional piece, suitable for various digital environments or as a stylized representation of technology.
